name: Autonomous Engineering Strategy

strategic_framework.thesis: Zero-Config Power — work immediately, scale optionally
strategic_framework.positioning: NOT competing with BullMQ on Redis/monitoring, own the zero-config niche

decisions.title: Plugin-based Backend System
decisions.rationale: Keep core zero-dep, let users add persistence via plugins

decisions.title: Rate Limiting as First-Class Feature
decisions.rationale: Most requested feature, easy to implement, high value

decisions.title: Task Deduplication
decisions.rationale: Prevents duplicate work in distributed systems

decisions.title: NO Pipeline/Chain API (v2.0)
decisions.rationale: Complex, low demand for lightweight queue

decisions.title: NO Worker Thread Support (v2.0)
decisions.rationale: Requires architecture change, most use process-based workers

lessons: Strategic analysis should happen BEFORE implementation, not after
ADR (Architecture Decision Record) format forces clear rationale
Anti-features list is as important as feature list
Plugin architecture keeps core small while enabling growth
Market positioning: compete on simplicity, not features
